NecroCascArm0000.description: Death (Morrath). 07-24r: the scene arm, as a STATUS rather than the bespoke `cascadeArmed` flag. Nothing lets a rule write an arbitrary flag, so a flag would have kept the arming engine-owned; a status is writable here and readable by the watch rule below, and it shows on the token so 'am I armed?' stops being a memory test. The generic already-armed veto refuses a second use before cost.

handler.text: armed for the scene: when a creature drops to 0 HP within your Attunement Range (Black), each enemy within 10 ft of the body takes [Tier][Die] spirit — applied automatically. Remove the Cascade Armed icon to end it early.

NecroCascWatch00.description: Death (Morrath). 07-24r — the FIRST consumer of H8's `defeat` watch kind. The engine announces a qualifying live→0 crossing (one applier, not a PC, not a summon, not saved by a Death Ward — the shared preconditions the announcement sits behind), and this rule decides whether it is yours: `rangeColor: black` against the BODY, `requireSelfStatus` for the scene arm. `payloadTarget: actor` because a defeat has one party, and the splash below is measured from that creature.

NecroCascDeton00.description: Death (Morrath). The detonation: one [Tier][Die on Black] spirit roll applied to each ENEMY within 10 ft of the body. `nearAffects: enemies` is new (07-24r) and is what keeps the splash off your own side; edhaTokensWithin already excludes the corpse itself, and downed creatures are skipped. The formula duplicates the talent's own damage line because a triggered effect always carries its own — edit BOTH if you retune it.

Cost: 4 Investiture

The door is barred, not locked. He keeps a key.

Spend 4 Investiture and touch the remains of a character that died within the last hour, consuming a Harvested Remain if one represents the target. The character returns to life with 1 HP and one additional injury. The raised character acts on your initiative and is Disoriented until the end of its next turn. Once per scene.

description.value:
Activation: 8

Every fall is an offering. The world only asked for the courtesy of catching it.

When a character drops to 0 HP within your Attunement Range, you recover 1 Investiture and mark the corpse as a Harvested Remain. You begin each scene with 1 Harvested Remain. You may sustain a number of Remains equal to your tier; unused Remains fade at the end of the scene. You sense each of your active Remains through any obstruction.

description.value:
Activation: 1

Cost: 1 Investiture

Rise. The work was not finished.

Spend 1 Investiture and a Harvested Remain to raise a Risen Servant in an adjacent space for the scene. The servant has HP equal to [Tier][Die], Speed 25 ft, defenses equal to yours minus 3, and one melee attack per turn dealing [Tier][Die] keen damage. It is immune to Frightened, Compelled, and Disoriented, and acts on your initiative immediately after your turn. You may sustain up to your tier Risen Servants.
